instruction: I went on a few trips each with some of my friends. My Simple Note has information on who owes whom what from each trip. I have already created Splitwise groups for the trips. Record the expenses accordingly in the respective groups.
notes: The exact number of trips/notes/expenses is only known at runtime; the model assumes two trip notes (found with one search_notes call on 'trip', then read with show_note each) and three 'who owes whom' entries (two in trip 1, one in trip 2), which yields the 11-call reference plan. Each note entry becomes one splitwise.record_expense in the matching pre-existing group: payer_email is the person owed, debtor_emails/debt_amounts the people who owe and their amounts, paid_amount the sum of the debts. Group ids and member emails are both read from a single splitwise.show_groups call (groups-listed); expense details are gated behind note-read so the planner must read the right note before recording. splitwise-record-expense carries the expense and note objects as non-API record parameters. supervisor-complete-task takes the three distinct expense objects (non-API parameters, equality constraints) so its precondition equals the problem's goal; no answer is needed. Only Expense/ExpenseShare (plus automatic notifications) are changed, matching the evaluation.
